about_the_game:
Dare your players to spend the night in a mansion that definitely looks haunted with the KR Gothic Castle Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a MV/MZ-sized tileset to let you create interior and exterior maps for a dark castle. Have your heroes approach the large entrance through a garden of small flowers and bramble hedges, and set your players on edge with looming dark spires stabbing up into the sky and large stained glass windows that don’t let nearly as much light through as you would expect. Visit abandoned chapels, courtyards with broken fountains, kitchens with half-drunk glasses of red wine (it is wine, right?) sitting on the otherwise empty counters, bedrooms with ornate untouched beds and worn coffins tucked in the corners, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are filled with desaturated tiles perfect for creating creepy locations. Trap your heroes in the castle until their mission is completed with wrought-iron fences surrounding the buildings, and decorate stone walls with carved inlays and arches in between ornate windows. Have your heroes search through libraries with towering bookshelves and paintings hanging on wallpapered walls in the hopes of finding a clue on who used to live there, or have them hunt down sneaky vampires by finding staircases into stone basements that were hidden under metal stoves or in the large fireplace that unlocked when the nearby organ plays a certain melody. This pack also includes 10 character images of doors and water fountains to help your players get around the mansion and to add some subtle movement to the garden maps. Pick up the KR Gothic Castle Tileset and add a spooky haunted house sidequest to your game!


Contents:

Ground tiles:

water
grass, dirt, and stone
rugs
fancy border tiles
fences
and more!

Wall tiles:

plain stone
panel walls
stone with borders
fancy wallpaper
dark stone
hedges
thorns
and more!

Also includes:

plenty of interior furniture
stained glass
tons of architectural details
towers for the outside of your castle
fountains and statues
color-coordinated foliage
and more!

Events and Animations:

fire animation
lots of doors
animated fountains in several sizes


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games

short_description: Somewhere in the forest of a forgotten country is a legendary castle. Could it be the haunt of a prince with a long-lost throne? A ruin with nothing but ghosts roaming its halls? The home of an ancient vampire? It's up to you!
